summary: A word game against a comedy creator group, and the top comment is from the guests' own official account asking for a rematch — which sets up a sequel for free and signals a working cross-channel relationship. The channel replies underneath asking whether viewers want to see more with them. Namhom is again singled out as naturally funny in every line she speaks. The recurring structural complaint returns: viewers want more rounds because it was over too quickly. A prank call placed to Violette during the game is picked out as the highlight, and one viewer proposes a specific follow-up game format by name.

audience_signals: A guest creator publicly asking for a rematch is the cheapest possible sequel commissioning — the demand, the cast and the cross-promotion are all pre-agreed in the comments
Runtime and round count are the persistent complaints across every game episode; the format is consistently under-served rather than over-long
Supporting cast members outperform the hosts on comedy in this format, which argues for building game episodes around the wider crew
Viewers name specific game formats they want next, so the format pipeline can be sourced from comments rather than invented
